protocol.scope: User-authorized stress test of passive fluid markers in the existing unforced Navier-Stokes flow, not a molecular interaction model.
protocol.markers: Two 5x5x5 clouds: central neighborhood centered at (0,0,0), and periodic-join neighborhood centered at the 64-grid initial global spin maximum. Lattice spacing is 6/64; offsets are -2,-1,0,1,2 spacings. The same physical initial positions are used across grids.
protocol.perturbed_markers: One companion for each of the 250 markers, displaced by exactly 1% of the initial lattice spacing along a seeded random direction, seed 104. These perturb marker positions only, not fluid velocity.
protocol.identical_clones: Five exact initial-position copies check that changing a label does not change motion.
protocol.edges: 600 fixed links between adjacent lattice sites: 300 per cloud. No pair forces.
protocol.tracking: RK4; periodic trilinear spatial interpolation; linear temporal interpolation between saved velocities. Unwrapped coordinates integrated, shortest periodic displacement used for comparisons.
protocol.controls: 64-grid tracking steps 0.000625, 0.0003125, 0.00015625; repeat finest step with velocity snapshots coarsened from 0.01 to 0.02; use fluid half-step 64-grid fields at finest tracking step; use 128-grid fields at tracking steps 0.0003125 and 0.00015625.
diagnostics: Individual speeds and velocities relative to each cloud mean
protocol.exploratory_path_screen: Maximum marker discrepancy <=5% of the initial lattice spacing (0.0046875) for each comparison; report early through0.10 and full through0.30 separately. This is a descriptive screen, not a physical accuracy bound.
limits: Markers are fluid parcels, not H2O molecules. No molecular fluctuation is added.
The original raw start has a periodic-join mismatch and unresolved vorticity peaks.
Grids have different sampled initial fields, energies and means; grid sensitivity includes those differences.
Temporal coarsening is a sensitivity test, not a bound on saved-time interpolation error.
A finite-time marker perturbation ratio is not an asymptotic Lyapunov exponent.
Crowding of labels does not imply compression of incompressible fluid; labels do not fill equal conserved volumes.
No start, viscosity, force, fluid method, matrix, or fluid time interval is changed.

additional_tracking_control.reason: The 128-grid 0.0003125-to0.00015625 tracking comparison exceeded the declared path-discrepancy screen. Add exactly one half step to distinguish tracking error from the much larger grid sensitivity.
